# WINCOME Hair Accessories

> WINCOME is a custom hair accessories manufacturer and OEM/ODM supplier for brands, wholesalers, retailers, and importers. The company produces hair clips, claw clips, headbands, scrunchies, hair bows, and private-label collections with low minimum order quantities and worldwide shipping.

WINCOME was established in 2010. Its 3,000 square metre factory has more than 200 staff and serves over 500 brands in 50 countries. Manufacturing and quality systems include BSCI, ISO 9001, and OEKO-TEX related capabilities. Buyers can request material, colour, size, finish, logo, packaging, and shipping customisation.

## Product categories

- [Custom hair claw clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/hair-claw-clips): Acetate, metal, plastic and resin claw clips with custom sizes, teeth, springs, colors and packaging.
- [Custom headbands](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/headbands): Padded, satin, velvet, knotted, braided and pearl headbands for private-label collections.
- [Custom scrunchies](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/scrunchies): Silk, satin, velvet and cotton scrunchies with custom sizing, elastic, labels and packaging.
- [Custom hair bows](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/hair-bows): Satin, grosgrain, oversized and multi-layer bows with custom clip hardware and branding.
- [Custom hair clips and barrettes](https://wincomehair.com/products/category/hair-clips-barrettes): Acetate, matte, pearl, crystal and flower clips and barrettes.

- [Cellulose acetate hair claw clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/claw-acetate): Custom acetate claw clips for private-label collections.
- [Butterfly hair claw clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/claw-butterfly): Decorative butterfly claw clips with custom colours and finishes.
- [Velvet scrunchies](https://wincomehair.com/products/scrunchie-velvet): Custom velvet scrunchies with logo and packaging options.
- [Silk scrunchies](https://wincomehair.com/products/scrunchie-silk): Private-label silk scrunchies in custom sizes and colours.
- [Braided velvet headbands](https://wincomehair.com/products/headband-braided): Padded and braided headbands for wholesale orders.
- [Bow hair clips](https://wincomehair.com/products/bow-clip): Custom fabric bow clips for retail and fashion brands.

## Commercial facts

- Minimum order quantity starts from 100 pieces per design for selected products.
- Standard production lead time is generally 10 to 18 days after sample approval, depending on the product and order.
- Custom services include product design, material selection, colour matching, logos, labels, cards, and gift boxes.
- International shipping options include sea freight and express air services. Amazon FBA direct shipping is supported.
